purpose: Manages transaction-local RLS context for multi-tenancy. Each protected operation gets its own transaction with app.user_id set via PostgreSQL set_config(), scoped to transaction lifetime. Provides executeWithContext() for multi-query operations and querySingleWithContext() for single-query guards.

symbols.name: executeWithContext
symbols.signature: async executeWithContext<T>(userId: string, queryFn: (connection: PoolClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>

symbols.name: querySingleWithContext
symbols.signature: async querySingleWithContext<T>(userId: string, query: string, params: any[]): Promise<T | null>

invariants: Each executeWithContext() call acquires a fresh connection from pool; no connection reuse across calls
Transaction scope: BEGIN → SET RLS context → queries → COMMIT/ROLLBACK → release connection
RLS context (app.user_id) is transaction-scoped via set_config(..., true); auto-clears on COMMIT/ROLLBACK
All queries within queryFn MUST use provided PoolClient; never use global pool or Drizzle instance
Connection guaranteed released in finally block even if queryFn throws; transaction rolled back
userId parameter authenticated server-side only; never client-supplied
Missing or null userId results in set_config failure or RLS filter returning 0 rows
known_limitations: Tests mock PoolClient; do not validate actual PostgreSQL RLS enforcement (RLS tested via integration tests in loyalty module)
executeWithContext does not support nested transactions or savepoints (Phase 2+ feature if needed)
Connection pool exhaustion not tested (pool capacity assumption: Node process has sufficient connections)
Error messages do not distinguish RLS violations from query syntax errors (both throw UnauthorizedException in guards)
caveats: TESTED_WITH: Jest unit tests mocking pg.Pool and PoolClient
NOT_TESTED_WITH: Actual PostgreSQL instance; RLS policy enforcement delegated to integration tests
NOT_TESTED_WITH: Concurrent requests competing for connection pool slots
ASSUMPTION: DatabaseService.getPool() returns functional pg.Pool instance (not verified in TenantContextService tests)
ASSUMPTION: PostgreSQL set_config() with transaction-local scope works as documented (library-delegated behavior)
